title: Design: Credit Hold banner shows on the work order Finance tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B with customer A picked as its Bill To, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Put customer A on Credit Hold (Edit Customer, Credit Terms: Credit Hold).
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p3-16-after-finance.png, bt-p3-15-before-finance.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Click the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Credit Hold pill shows.

Step 2:

  • The same pink banner with "Change Bill To" shows under the Finance toolbar.
  • The toolbar (Customer PO, icons, Add Deposit, Create Invoice) keeps its production place.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R6: “If the Bill To is on Credit Hold, the Credit Hold banner reads M2 with a "Change Bill To" button (work orders: page header; part sales: Finance tab).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
